parts.name: Root
parts.description: The container with the state. It holds the time value, the open state of the popover, and the granularity and hour-cycle settings. The input and the clock share them.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the root element. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: value
props.description: The time value ('HH:mm' or 'HH:mm:ss'). You can bind it. The empty state is null.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The time value at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the time value changes. When a wheel stops on a value, the component immediately makes that value the new value.

props.name: minValue
props.description: The first time that the user can select. A wheel item out of the range is disabled. If the user types a time out of the range, the input becomes invalid. A range that goes through midnight is not possible.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The last time that the user can select. A wheel item out of the range is disabled. If the user types a time out of the range, the input becomes invalid.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Sets the 12-hour cycle or the 24-hour cycle. The default comes from the active locale. The 12-hour cycle adds an AM/PM segment and a day-period column, but each value stays a 24-hour value.

props.name: granularity
props.description: The smallest unit that the user can edit: 'hour', 'minute', or 'second'. With 'hour', the value is HH:00.

props.name: hourStep
props.description: The step between the hours that the user can select.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: The step between the minutes that the user can select.

props.name: secondStep
props.description: The step between the seconds that the user can select.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input segments, the trigger, and the wheels.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the input focusable, but stops the changes.

props.name: required
props.description: Makes the time picker required for the form validation.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state of the popover. You can bind it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state of the popover at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the popover opens or closes. The details give the cause and a `cancel()` function that stops the change.

props.name: children
props.description: The TimePicker parts that you assemble in the root.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the time picker, for when the user sees no name.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: The time input with segments. It goes through the segments of the locale and gives each one to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Makes one segment for each part. It receives the data of the segment. The default is a plain segment.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the input with segments.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the time picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while a segment inside the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the text in the segments does not make a valid value.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popover is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the time picker is readonly.

parts.name: Segment
parts.description: One segment of the time: the hour, the minute, the second, the day period, or a separator. The user can type in it, and the arrow keys change its value.

props.name: segment
props.description: The data of the segment, from the children snippet of the Input.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment shows its placeholder and not a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-time-picker-segment
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a time picker segment element.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The segment type, for example 'hour', 'minute', 'second', 'dayPeriod', or 'literal'.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that opens and closes the clock popover.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button, for example a clock icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the trigger has focus.

parts.name: Popover
parts.description: The panel that floats and contains the clock. It accepts Popover.Content props, for example placement, offset, and shouldFlip. The component controls the open state, the reference to the trigger, and the id. The default placement is bottom, and the focus goes first to the first wheel column.

props.name: offset
props.description: The distance from the anchor element, on the main axis.

props.name: placement
props.description: The position against the anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Moves the panel to the opposite side when the space is not sufficient.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: The element that gives the limits of the position.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the popover.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the popover container.

props.name: nonModal
props.description:
Makes the popover non-modal. The user can then operate the page, the focus does not stay in
the panel, and the page scrolls.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Closes the popover when the user clicks outside it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Closes the popover when the user pushes the `Escape` key.

props.name: shouldCloseOnBlur
props.description: Closes the popover when the focus goes out of it. The default is true for a non-modal popover.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: The element, or the selector of the element, that gets the focus first in the modal mode.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state, when you use the part alone.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: The reference to the trigger element, when you use the part alone.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state changes, when you use the part alone.

parts.name: Clock
parts.description: The wheels in the popover. It calculates the columns from the state of the root: granularity and hourCycle. The sequence is always the same: the hour, then the minute, then the second, then the day period.

props.name: column
props.description: Your own content for each column. It receives { type, label? } for each column. If you give none, the component makes the default columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-clock
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the clock element.

parts.name: WheelColumn
parts.description: One wheel that scrolls, with role="spinbutton", for one segment: the hour, the minute, the second, or the day period.

props.name: type
props.description: The segment that this wheel changes: 'hour', 'minute', 'second', or 'dayPeriod'.

props.name: children
props.description: It receives the option, and a boolean that is true for the selected value of the column.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the column. The default is the localized name of the segment.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while the column contains focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-wheel-highlight
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the column's central highlight band.

dataAttributes.name: data-wheel-spacer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the spacers that let an item at an end reach the center.

parts.name: WheelItem
parts.description: An item in a wheel column, with no styles. It makes one option and shows its state in data attributes. You write all of the styles.

props.name: type
props.description: The segment type of the column of this item.

props.name: option
props.description: The wheel option, from the children snippet of the column.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the item as selected. In the column snippet, the component takes this value from the state of the root.

props.name: onRequestCenter
props.description: The component calls it when the item must go to the center of the wheel.

dataAttributes.name: data-centered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is at the center of the wheel.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the user cannot select the item, because it is out of the range or not on a step.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is the value of its column.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The segment type of the item's column.

dataAttributes.name: data-value
dataAttributes.description: The option value the item represents.

dataAttributes.name: data-wheel-item
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a wheel item element.
